name: Pimoroni Audio DAC SHIM
description: HiFiBerry-compatible I2S DAC SHIM for line-out audio on the Raspberry Pi
notes: HiFiBerry DAC-compatible I2S line-out SHIM used with Squeezelite. Uses the Pi's I2S bus: BCLK on GPIO18, LRCLK on GPIO19 and DATA on GPIO21. Power (5V/GND/3V3) is taken from the header rails.
